name: Coinbase One Card

base_rate.description: 2% Bitcoin back at Tier 1 (Assets on Coinbase under $10,000). Higher tiers earn 2.5%, 3% or 4% on the first $10,000 in eligible purchases per calendar month, then 2%.

categories.label: Flights, hotels and cars booked through Coinbase One Card Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Bitcoin rewards are credited to the Coinbase digital asset wallet.

notes: Serviced by Cardless, Inc. and offered through Coinbase, Inc. An active, paid Coinbase One membership (from $49.99 per year) is required to open and keep the card and to earn rewards; the card itself has no annual fee. Rewards tier depends on Assets on Coinbase. No American Express network package applies, so network_tier is none.
